legal.privacyDesc: This policy explains how Testnia collects, uses, and protects your personal data in compliance with GDPR.
legal.termsDesc: By using Testnia, you agree to these terms covering user conduct, subscriptions, and our liability.
legal.cookiePolicyDesc: This policy explains what cookies Testnia uses, why we use them, and how you can control them.
legal.whoWeAreText: Testnia is an online exam preparation platform designed for African students. Our registered operator can be contacted at contact@testnia.com.
legal.dataWeCollectIntro: When you use Testnia, we may collect the following categories of personal data:
legal.dataItem1: Account information: email address, full name, country, and language preference
legal.dataItem2: Study data: practice session results, essay submissions, scores, and progress statistics
legal.dataItem3: Payment data: transaction references processed via Paystack (we do not store card numbers)
legal.dataItem4: Usage data: pages visited, features used, and session timestamps
legal.dataItem5: Device data: browser type, operating system, and IP address
legal.howWeUseDataText: We use your personal data for the following purposes:
legal.useItem1: Providing and personalising your exam preparation experience
legal.useItem2: Processing subscription payments and sending receipts
legal.useItem3: Improving our question banks and AI feedback models
legal.useItem4: Sending service emails such as welcome messages and payment confirmations
legal.dataStorageText: Your data is stored on secure servers hosted within the European Union. We use encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest. Access is restricted to authorised staff only. We retain account data for as long as your account is active, and up to 90 days after deletion.
legal.dataSharingText: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with service providers necessary to operate Testnia, including Paystack (payment processing) and our hosting provider. All processors are bound by data processing agreements.
legal.yourRightsIntro: If you are located in the EEA, UK, or similar jurisdiction, you have the following rights:
legal.right1: Right to access — request a copy of the data we hold about you
legal.right2: Right to rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
legal.right3: Right to erasure — request deletion of your account and data
legal.right4: Right to restriction — limit how we process your data
legal.right5: Right to data portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format
legal.right6: Right to object — opt out of processing for direct marketing
legal.yourRightsContact: To exercise any of these rights, email us at contact@testnia.com. We will respond within 30 days.
legal.dataRetentionText: We keep your personal data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we will erase your personal data within 30 days, except where we are required by law to retain it longer.
legal.cookiesRefText: We use cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences. For full details, see our
legal.contactUsText: For any privacy or data questions, please contact us at contact@testnia.com.
legal.termsAcceptanceText: By accessing or using Testnia, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our service.
legal.termsEligibilityText: You must be at least 13 years old to create a Testnia account. By registering, you confirm you meet this age requirement. Users under 18 should have parental consent.
legal.termsAccountsText: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Notify us immediately at contact@testnia.com if you suspect unauthorised access.
legal.conduct1: Share, resell, or distribute Testnia content without written permission
legal.conduct2: Attempt to reverse-engineer, scrape, or copy our question banks or AI models
legal.conduct3: Upload harmful, illegal, or misleading content via the essay or support tools
legal.conduct4: Circumvent subscription limits or payment processing
legal.conduct5: Impersonate another user or misrepresent your identity
legal.termsSubscriptionsText: Testnia offers a free Freemium plan and a paid Premium plan. Premium subscriptions are billed monthly and provide access to unlimited practice, essay submissions, leaderboard access, and an ad-free experience. Subscription terms begin on the date of successful payment.
legal.termsPaymentsText: Payments are processed by Paystack, a third-party payment processor. By subscribing, you authorise us to charge your selected payment method. All prices are displayed inclusive of applicable taxes where required.
legal.termsRefundsText: Due to the digital nature of our service, we do not offer refunds once a subscription period has started. If you experience a technical issue preventing access, please contact contact@testnia.com within 7 days and we will review your case.
legal.termsIPText: All content on Testnia — including questions, explanations, AI-generated feedback, and platform code — is owned by or licensed to Testnia. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our express written consent.
legal.termsLiabilityText: Testnia is provided 'as is'. We make no warranties that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Testnia shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.
legal.termsTerminationText: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or abuse the platform. You may delete your account at any time from the account settings or by emailing us.
legal.termsGoverningText: These terms are governed by applicable law. Disputes will be resolved through binding arbitration or the competent courts in the jurisdiction of the user's country of residence.
legal.termsChangesText: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. We will notify you by email or in-app notice at least 14 days before material changes take effect. Continued use of Testnia after changes constitutes acceptance.
legal.whatAreCookiesText: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences, keep you signed in, and gather anonymised usage statistics. Testnia uses three categories of cookies.
legal.essentialCookiesText: These cookies are necessary for Testnia to function. They keep you signed in, remember your language setting, and store your cookie consent preference. You cannot opt out of essential cookies.
legal.analyticsCookiesText: With your consent, we use anonymised analytics to understand how students use Testnia — which subjects are most practised, where drop-off occurs, and how the AI feedback is received. This helps us improve the platform. No personal identifiers are shared with analytics providers.
legal.marketingCookiesText: Freemium users see ads that help fund the platform. Marketing cookies allow us to show ads that are more relevant to your interests. If you opt out, you may still see ads, but they will be less personalised.
legal.manageCookiesText: You can update your cookie preferences at any time. Click the button below to open the preferences panel. You can also clear all cookies by clearing your browser storage.
